name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual non-disclosure agreement covering confidentiality obligations, permitted disclosures, term, and return of confidential information.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page template for the Mutual NDA with fill-in fields for party details, purpose, effective date, term, governing law, and signatures.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Comprehensive agreement for cloud-based software services covering access and use, restrictions, privacy and security, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-access design partner programs covering product access, feedback, fees, term and termination, disclaimer of warranties, confidentiality, and IP assignment of feedback to the provider.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Agreement defining uptime commitments, response time obligations, and service credits or remedies for a cloud service.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Agreement for professional services engagements covering statement of work, deliverables, IP ownership (provider assigns deliverables to customer), payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, insurance, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR-compliant data processing agreement covering processor and subprocessor relationships, processing instructions, restricted transfers (EEA SCCs and UK Addendum), security incident response, audit rights, data deletion, and liability.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Agreement for licensing software to customers covering license grant, restrictions, payment, term and termination, warranties, disclaimer, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement for business partnerships covering cooperation and obligations, payment, trademark license, privacy, escalation procedure, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Agreement for product pilots and evaluations covering access and use on an AS IS basis, term, termination, disclaimer of warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant BAA covering business associate obligations (safeguards, subcontractors, individual requests), company obligations, data rights, breach notification, and term and termination.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum for AI and machine learning services covering permitted use, restrictions, model training controls, IP ownership (customer owns output), personal data obligations, and disclaimers on AI accuracy and output similarity.
